title: Reduce presubmit I/O and add lightweight release prober
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: presubmit latency and flakiness have increased due to heavy I/O (container pulls, repeated dependency installs, large integration fixture downloads). This PR reduces presubmit I/O by introducing a fast-presubmit profile, a toolchain lease for ephemeral runner cache reuse, and dependency-visibility heuristics so that only modules touched by the change install their deps. In addition, a lightweight release-prober workflow is added to smoke-check release bundles before the formal release window. Goals: 1) speed up common presubmit feedback loops (lint/unit) to <= 2m for small changes; 2) shift expensive integration artifacts to nightly or staged lanes; 3) provide a low-cost pre-release smoke check to catch packaging/regression regressions before human release checks. Summary of approach and changes: - Add .github/actions/fast-presubmit.yml and adapt presubmit dispatcher to pick profiles by changed paths and commit message flags (CI_FAST=true). - Add a toolchain lease agent (scripts/toolchain_lease.go + ci/toolchain-lease-proxy) that acquires a short-lived lease for runner-local cache volumes so concurrent CI jobs reuse image layers and node_modules across short windows instead of re-pulling every job. - Introduce dependency-visibility logic in the presubmit orchestrator (ci/presubmit/dep_visibility.py) which computes minimal dep sets for changed packages and only installs those. - Slim CI base images (docker/ci/Dockerfile.slim) and add Makefile targets for layer-splitting to reduce download size. - Move heavy integration tests and large fixture downloads into nightly/integration lanes and add gating in presubmit to only run smoke variants. - Implement .github/workflows/release-prober.yml: on candidate tag, run a 3-step smoke flow (install, basic e2e (10m), package integrity) with clear failure reasons and artifacts. - Emit telemetry: presubmit.profile and toolchain.lease.hits to help tune thresholds. Checklist: - [x] fast-presubmit action and dispatcher wired into existing presubmit workflow - [x] toolchain lease prototype and integration tests - [x] dep-visibility heuristics with test coverage and fallbacks - [x] release-prober manifest and runbook - [x] docs updated (ci/README.md) - [x] Linear tickets linked: ENG-3142 and ENG-3210 Notable constraints/rollbacks: the dep-visibility has a conservative fallback (full-install) when file mappings are ambiguous to avoid flakiness. The toolchain lease includes rate limits to prevent noisy cache thrashing on peak CI usage. Related work: follows earlier presubmit decomposition efforts (see ENG-2101), and complements nightly canary work to keep integration coverage.
